business_problem: A PLUS JAPAN needed globally stable infrastructure for online games, with strong database performance and network reliability for overseas users, while keeping operating costs under control.
solution_summary: A PLUS JAPAN relies on Alibaba Cloud to support the global rollout of licensed game titles, prioritizing stability for players who connect from many different countries and regions. The environment combines Elastic Compute Service for application compute, Object Storage Service for shared and static data, Tair and ApsaraDB RDS for high-speed and relational database services, PolarDB for scalable cloud-native persistence, and Server Load Balancer for traffic distribution. Although the customer story focuses more on operational results than the exact request path, the overall architecture is clearly designed to keep database performance and network quality stable for remote players while giving the team sufficient flexibility to debug overseas issues in real time through Alibaba support. By moving onto Alibaba Cloud and standardizing around this managed infrastructure set, A PLUS JAPAN created a lower-cost global game platform that can continue expanding as new regional data center locations come online.
business_outcome: A PLUS JAPAN improved stability for overseas game users and cut infrastructure costs by about half while supporting global expansion.
architecture_clues: Game access must remain stable for users in remote locations
Database performance and network stability are called out as critical design goals
The company uses Alibaba support to debug overseas issues in real time
Future expansion depends on more global data center locations
evidence_quotes: "Database performance and network stability are critical to the global expansion of game titles."
"Compared to costs required before the migration, A Plus were able to reduce costs by approximately 50%."
"A PLUS JAPAN uses Alibaba Cloud services to ensure stable database performance, reliable network connectivity, and cost-efficient infrastructure to support the global expansion of its game titles."

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service
solution_components.role: Runs the game application infrastructure for global releases.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service
solution_components.role: Stores shared game assets and related data.

solution_components.name: Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible)
solution_components.role: Provides low-latency caching for game services.

solution_components.name: Server Load Balancer
solution_components.role: Distributes player traffic across backend services.

solution_components.name: ApsaraDB RDS
solution_components.role: Provides managed relational database services for game operations.

data_flow: Player requests reach game services through a load-balanced application tier, execute on ECS-backed workloads, read and write fast-changing state through Tair and managed databases, and retrieve supporting assets from Object Storage Service.
